arxiv-2211-00961.title: Sifting composite from elementary models at FCCee and CePC
arxiv-2211-00961.creator: G. Cacciapaglia 1,2, A. Deandrea 1,2, A.M. Iyer 3, A. Pinto 1,2,4
arxiv-2211-00961.description: Abstract New Physics models with either an elementary or composite origin are often associated with a similar imprint in a direct search at colliders, case in point being the production of a light pseudoscalar in association with a monochromatic photon from the decay of a Z boson at future e + e − e+e- colliders.

arxiv-2307-12269.title: The electronic structure of intertwined kagome, honeycomb, and triangular sublattices of the intermetallics MCo 2 Al 9
arxiv-2307-12269.creator: Chiara Bigi, Sahar Pakdel, Michał J. Winiarski, Pasquale Orgiani, Ivana Vobornik, Jun Fujii, Giorgio Rossi, Vincent Polewczyk, Phil D.C. King, Giancarlo Panaccione, Tomasz Klimczuk, Kristian Sommer Thygesen, Federico Mazzola
arxiv-2307-12269.description: Abstract Intermetallics are an important playground to stabilize a large variety of physical phenomena, arising from their complex crystal structure. The ease of their chemical tuneabilty makes them suitable platforms to realize targeted electronic properties starting from the symmetries hidden in their unit cell.

arxiv-2312-07845.title: Gap Theorem on manifolds with small curvature concentration
arxiv-2312-07845.creator: Pak-Yeung Chan, Man-Chun Lee
arxiv-2312-07845.description: Abstract . In this work, we show that complete non-compact manifolds with non-negative Ricci curvature, Euclidean volume growth and sufficiently small curvature concentration are necessarily flat Euclidean space. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 53E20 1. Introduction One of the fundamental goal of Riemannian geometry is to investigate the underlying structure of a manifold.

arxiv-2511-00067.title: Latent Domain Prompt Learning for Vision-Language Models
arxiv-2511-00067.creator: Zhixing Li, Arsham Gholamzadeh Khoee, Yinan Yu
arxiv-2511-00067.description: Abstract The objective of domain generalization (DG) is to enable models to be robust against domain shift. DG is crucial for deploying vision-language models (VLMs) in real-world applications, yet most existing methods rely on domain labels that may not be available and often ambiguous.

pmc-10737423.title: AGE-RELATED HEARING LOSS IN COMMUNITY PHARMACY: BARRIERS AND FACILITATORS TO COMMUNICATION
pmc-10737423.creator: Penny Lewis, Shanice Thomas, Jane Griffiths, Denham Phipps, Gabrielle Saunders, Christopher Todd
pmc-10737423.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Pharmacists have an important role in primary care, communicating with people and ensuring safe and appropriate medication use. However, inadequate communication is a barrier to the delivery of effective care for people with hearing loss. This study sought to explore factors that facilitate and impede communication with people with age-related hearing loss (presbycusis) in the community pharmacy, in order to identify solutions to improve these interactions.

pmc-11465518.title: Crohn’s disease presenting with pleural effusion: a case report
pmc-11465518.creator: Harem K Ahmed, Dilan S Hiwa, Soran H Tahir, Rawa M Ali, Dana T Gharib, Hoshmand R Asaad, Karokh F Hamahussein, Ayoob A Mohammed, Kayhan A Najar, Fahmi H Kakamad
pmc-11465518.description: Crohn’s disease (CD) is a granulomatous inflammatory bowel disease. Around 25% of CD patients exhibit extraintestinal manifestations, though pulmonary involvement is rare. This study presents a case of CD causing pleural effusion. A 43-year-old man visited the pulmonology clinic with a dry cough for one-month, right-side pleuritic chest pain, and exertional dyspnea.

pmc-11472143.title: Stress as a possible trigger in anti–N-methyl-ᴅ-aspartate receptor encephalitis: a case series
pmc-11472143.creator: Sheikh Hilal Ahmad, Atif Kawoosa, Tanveer Hassan, Bashir Sanaie
pmc-11472143.description: Anti-N-methyl-ᴅ-aspartate receptor (NMDAR) encephalitis is a rare disease with a range of neurological and psychiatric presentations. Antibodies against NMDAR receptor are purported to be pathologic, and the two known potential immunological triggers are tumors and viral infection. In half of the cases, the trigger is not known. We present two cases where stress seemed to have triggered encephalitis.

pmc-11484924.title: Proposals of indigenous peoples and local communities from Brazil for multilateral benefit-sharing from digital sequence information
pmc-11484924.creator: Adriana de Souza de Lima, Cristiane Gomes Julião, Elizete Maria da Silva, Alberto Franca Dias, Jhonny Martins de Jesus, Marciano Toledo da Silva, Emmanuel Duarte Almada, Jaqueline Pereira de Andrade, Nurit Bensusan, Sofia Zank, Gustavo Taboada Soldati
pmc-11484924.description: One of the main themes of the 16th Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity is Digital Sequence Information (DSI): genomic or related data deposited in publicly accessible databases in a digital language. These sequences are important for research in areas such as biodiversity conservation and bioprospecting.

pmc-11565041.description: ed milk products in the US. As of late September 2024, 15 states have been affected, with confirmed reports of four human cases, all of whom had directly contacted with infected cattle, ten cases with exposure to poultry, and one case without known exposure to infected birds or animals.

pmc-12505930.title: The role of ChatGPT in clinical practice: perceptions, expectations and future implications amongst the clinical faculty
pmc-12505930.creator: Laiba Zahir, Laloona Hussian, Wahab Zia, Iqbal Haider
pmc-12505930.description: Background & Objective:Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming various industries, including healthcare. ChatGPT, introduced by OpenAI, is an advanced AI model with potential applications in medical practice. However, its reliability and effectiveness in clinical settings remain under investigation. This study explored the perspectives of healthcare professionals regarding the integration of ChatGPT in clinical practice, focusing on perceptions, expectations, and implications.

pmc-12603450.title: Strategies for improving biomarker testing rates in non-small cell lung cancer in north America: a scoping review
pmc-12603450.creator: Ana S. Salazar, Jose Noy, John M. Reynolds, Courtney Granville, E Rodriguez, Coral Olazagasti, Shanada Monestime
pmc-12603450.description: BackgroundBiomarker testing plays a pivotal role in the management of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). However, despite advancements in diagnostic technologies and clinical guidelines recommending widespread use, the adoption of biomarker testing in routine practice remains inconsistent. To address these gaps, this study summarizes the common barriers to biomarker testing in NSCLC and highlights practical solutions to increase utilization.

pmc-12697789.title: Transfer Learning and Permutation‐Invariance Improving Predicting Genome‐Wide, Cell‐Specific and Directional Interventions Effects of Complex Systems
pmc-12697789.creator: Boyang Wang, Boyu Pan, Tingyu Zhang, Qingyuan Liu, Shao Li
pmc-12697789.description: With the rise of precision medicine, single‐drug treatments alone may not meet its demands. However, extensive data and deep learning models exist for single compounds. Leveraging transfer learning to use this data for predicting complex system intervention effects is promising.

pmc-13345964.title: The influence of reproductive mode on resource competition and diversity patterns in Ediacaran early animal communities
pmc-13345964.creator: Emily G. Mitchell, Andrea Manica
pmc-13345964.description: The appearance of the oldest known animals during the late Ediacaran period (~574 million years ago) was followed by a phase of slow diversification, until a later burst of rapid diversification known as the Ediacaran ‘second wave’. The reasons behind the tempo of diversification are poorly understood.
